```{r}
library(here)
here::i_am("dplyr101.Rproj")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
View(diamonds)
data("diamonds")
```

## link between diamond carat and price 
```{r}
ggplot(diamonds,aes(x=carat,y=price))+
  geom_point()
```

## Selcting a subset of dataset

```{r}
#| echo: true
diamonds_2ct<-diamonds %>% filter(abs(carat-2)<0.1) 
View(diamonds_2ct)
ggplot(diamonds_2ct,aes(x=carat,y=price))+
  geom_point()
```
## Prices of 2 carat diamonds

```{r}
diamonds %>% filter(carat>=2 , carat<2.1) %>% ggplot(aes(x=carat,y=price,group=carat))+
  geom_boxplot()

```
